title: fix: prevent Podman system service to die in multi-stage built
body:
In concurrent multi-stage builds (`--jobs > 1`), if one stage fails, `Build()`'s cleanup sets `containerMap = nil`. Sibling stage goroutines that are still in-processing can subsequently reach `getImageRootfs()` and write into `s.executor.containerMap`, since this is empty map it will cause a error `panic: assignment to entry in nil map`. When running via `podman system service`, this crash kills the entire daemon process.

RootCause : 
when a stage fails the cleanup() of that container is hit, which sets `containerMap = nil`, if other gortoutine of the other stages tries to write into it, it fails and prompt the `panic: assignment to entry in nil map`. it should first cancel all the other goroutines that are running concurrently and then set `containerMap = nil`

Fix : 
1. Cleanup only happens when all goroutines have exited: The defer cleanup() (which sets `containerMap = nil`) only runs after the main thread finishes waiting for all stage goroutines to completely finish and exit.
2. Context cancellation stops sibling goroutines early: A cancellable `ctx` is shared across all stages. When one stage fails, it calls cancel(), which signals all other in-processing sibling stages to abort their operations (RUN, COPY, image pulls) immediately.
3. Filter and prompting back correct errors
